content.study:
Deceit requires a false representation made knowingly, without belief in its truth or recklessly, intended to induce reliance and causing damage. Negligent misstatement is distinct and depends on a duty of care in making the statement.\
\
Derry v Peek sets the classic deceit standard. Hedley Byrne recognised negligent misstatement in appropriate relationships involving assumption of responsibility.
